source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
Flexential Dallas - Downtown Dallas in Dallas, Texas, publishes 6.66 MW of IT capacity across 80,000 square feet of technical space, operated by Flexential.

At 10 kW per rack, a common enterprise colocation density, that load supports roughly 666 racks. At 40 kW per rack, a density closer to AI training workloads, it supports roughly 166 racks. The operator has not published a per-rack power envelope, so neither figure is the operator's own claim, only what the published megawattage implies under each assumption.

Flexential Dallas - Downtown Dallas holds 4 published certifications: SOC 1 Type 2 (audited controls over financial reporting processes), SOC 2 Type 2 (audited controls over security, availability, and confidentiality, tested over time rather than at a point), HITRUST (a healthcare-focused security framework built on top of HIPAA), SSAE 18 (the attestation standard underlying SOC reports). Together these qualify the facility for regulated workloads spanning security auditing, payments, and healthcare data, though which specific tenants rely on which certification is not disclosed.

Texas has 23 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which 15 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 399.41 MW. Flexential Dallas - Downtown Dallas contributes 6.66 MW of that total. At that published size it is a small facility relative to what frontier AI training infrastructure requires, which now runs into the tens or hundreds of megawatts, though it may still support inference workloads or smaller-scale AI applications.
